dead_zone.description: How far the face may drift before the frame follows, in ten-thousandths of the window. Default 800.

hold_ms.description: How long the last position is held when no face is seen. Default 1500.

item_id.description: A clip of a video asset.

keyframe_ms.description: The least time between two keyframes, 50 to 5000 ms. Default 200.

max_pan.description: Fastest pan, in ten-thousandths of the source width per second. Default 6000.

smoothing_ms.description: Time constant of the smoothing, 0 to 5000 ms. Default 400.
